product.name: Workstream by Monoprice Extra Wide Non-slip High Precision Keyboard and Mouse Pad 36x12 inches 3mm Thick
product.description: This extra wide mouse pad measures 36" x 12" and provides a high precision work surface to get the highest performance and accuracy from your computer mouse. It is big enough to allow a keyboard and other input devices to be placed close together on the same surface for maximum comfort, preventing uneven and wobbly desk setups. The edges are lock-stitched to resist fraying and curling and to extend the useful life.Features: Large surface can fit your mouse and keyboardPrecision microfiber surface and antislip rubber bottom3mm thick material with edge stitching Support Files: Dimensions Diagram (Aug 14, 2018)Monoprice™, WORKSTREAM™, the WORKSTREAM logo, and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
